details.name: MOB.361_Work_Note_Edit_Delete
details.message:
`MOB.361` **Edit a job note, then delete it — each write proved on the server.**
- Adds its own note (`DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE 361 NOTE {{ RUNID }}`), proved over `/graphql` (exactly one, new).
- `Edit Item` → the tiptap editor prefilled → replaced with `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE 361 EDITED …` →
  `UPDATE_WORKSTAGE_JOB_NOTE`, proved over `/graphql` on that note's id.
- `Delete Item` → Yes → `REMOVE_JOB_NOTE_FROM_WORKSTAGE`, proved over `/graphql`: no marker note, and
  the note ids are exactly those before the run.
- 🛑 **Owner-authorised delete** (trap 2), this run's note only: guarded in the gear-click step by a
  server premise (no marker note before the run) and exactly one marker card. The delete leg is
  `always`, so a red run still removes its own note.
- 🛑 SELF-CLEANING — the fixture ends with exactly the notes it started with.
